dct_title_s: Montserrat, particulars of a valuable Sugar Estate : known as "Brodericks," situate in the Parish of Saint Anthony, in the Island of Montserrat, containing 376 acres or thereabouts, together with the fixtures, machinery and live and dead stock thereon : which will be sold by auction, in one lot, by Messrs. Hards, Vaughan & Jenkinson, before James Fleming, Esq., Q.C., and Reginald John Cust, Esq., Commissioners for Sale of Incumbered Estates in the West Indies, at the Sale Room of the Commissioners
